I have always believed that when I'm hanging out with friends I should make an effort to sometimes go alone. It's important to me to keep making an effort in my friendships and not give my friends the feeling that they're "in addition to my boyfriend". 4. I feel like sometimes inviting my boyfriend changes the vibe of hanging out, and while that's totally fine, sometimes I feel like my friends want to just hang out "the high school friends" or "just girls". I feel like I also sometimes want this specific vibe. I remember how much it bothered me when I thought that I was hanging out with a friend and I showed up to see that her boyfriend had come along too, even if I liked him I was a little bit sad that we wouldn't have our own time together. Overall I love my boyfriend and things are great when he comes along, but I feel that it's important for me to sometimes prioritize just friend things.
